title: Revision
description: Represents a claim improvement caused by objections or evidence.

run_id.description: Reference to the run this revision belongs to.

old_claim_id.description: ID of the claim before revision.

reason.description: Explanation of why the revision was made.

improvement_score.description: Measured improvement score, or null if not yet scored.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with this revision.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this revision was created.
